description: Rewrite the profile-dominant mega_eigh_clust_split_k and mega_eigh_med_split_k leaf solvers for SM100: batch variable-width leaves into a persistent global work queue, stage packed panels with TMA producer warps, use tcgen05 consumer warps for compact-WY updates/backtransforms, and dedicate reduction/control warps to remove CTA-wide barriers. Co-schedule n512 mixed leaves and n2048 spectral leaves while preserving existing route gates and FP32 cleanup.

Fused med/cluster twisted-factor forward pivots into Vout and reused DP for backward pivots, removing DM traffic and output zero-fill. Policy validation stopped before execution because comments contained the banned word stream.

Fused twisted-factorization forward pivots into Vout and reused DP for backward pivots in both med and cluster leaf kernels, removing the DM n*n write/read path and output zero-fill. Validation 39/39; aggregate 25438.617 us, mixed512 100426.870 us.

Distributed independent compact-WY panel Gram/T construction round-robin across cluster ranks instead of serializing on rank 0. Validation 39/39, but active rank tails reduced dependent-grid overlap: mixed512 111228.086 us and aggregate 26342.544 us.

Restored rank-0 compact-WY tail and replaced med/cluster amax and Gershgorin max/min trees with control-warp shuffle reductions. Lazy extension compilation failed and _mega_get silently selected cuSOLVER; benchmark 38885.798 us is fallback evidence and not attributed to the kernels.

Fixed stock-header build by using explicit FP32 extrema in med/cluster warp max/min reductions. Validation 39/39. Runtime was unstable: mixed512 124336.653 us (116135.773 best), aggregate 27213.040 us; removing the max/min CTA barriers did not improve this dependent-launch schedule.

Restored stable max/min trees and rank-0 compact-WY tail while retaining in-place twisted factors. Exact trial-1 source revalidated 39/39; aggregate 25395.974 us and mixed512 100269.089 us, confirming the fused-scratch path under a stable run.

Specialized the final two med-kernel warps to build alternating compact-WY panels concurrently with fused Sturm/twisted eigenvector work. Validation 39/39, but two warps serialized too many panel Gram dots: n352 13647 us, mixed512 112470 us, aggregate 31743.672 us.

Scaled compact-WY specialists to all idle warps and reserved per-warp shared Gram/T tiles. The n176 small-path validation reported a prior-kernel CUDA fault at its following cuBLAS call, so the adaptive specialization was not benchmarked.

Fused each med eigenvalue's bisection directly into its twisted-vector recurrence, removing the CTA handoff barrier. The megakernel extension did not load and the 38883.353 us benchmark is wholesale cuSOLVER fallback, so no performance metric is attributed.

Correctly scoped the med-only fused bisection/twisted stage: each eigenvalue owner carries lambda directly into its LDL recurrences, removing the intervening CTA barrier while retaining the full-CTA WY builder. Validation 39/39; branch-best aggregate 25293.735 us, mixed512 100485.982 us.

Extended per-eigenvalue bisection/twisted fusion to the cluster kernel, removing one CTA barrier plus one cluster-wide synchronization while preserving rank ownership. Validation 39/39; aggregate 25320.316 us, mixed512 100466.649 us.

Packed the compact-WY Gram as upper-triangular work in both med and cluster builders, computing only the entries consumed by the T recurrence while retaining CTA-wide parallelism. Validation 39/39; branch-best aggregate 25260.387 us, mixed512 99907.679 us, n352 6154.642 us.

Specialized the nb=32 compact-T recurrences to warp 0: column dependencies use warp barriers, followed by one CTA handoff before the parallel store, in both med and cluster builders. Validation 39/39; branch-best aggregate 25258.879 us, mixed512 99885.707 us.

Separated clustered compact-WY Gram and T shared tiles, removing the per-column Gram snapshot and one warp synchronization; expanded the stage-tail SMEM reservation without changing the hot triangle limit. Validation 39/39; branch-best 25204.208 us, mixed512 99511.629 us.

Added a capped persistent med grid with an atomic global job counter in unused DM scratch and preinitialized counters for dependent launches. The extension did not load; 38789.021 us is wholesale cuSOLVER fallback and is not attributed to the queue kernel.

Explored 15 logged trials and stopped on operator request with clean branch-best commit 0179c68b9. Valid work fused twisted forward/backward scratch into Vout+DP, fused bisection directly into twisted-vector ownership in med and cluster kernels, computed only the upper compact-WY Gram, moved nb=32 T recurrences to warp barriers, and separated cluster Gram/T tiles. Best full metric 25204.208 us (39/39), mixed512 99.512 ms; final nsys: cluster 46.298 ms, two med launches 30.316 ms. Distributed cluster panel tails measured 26342.544 us; two-warp concurrent panel construction 31743.672 us; control-warp max/min 27213.040 us. A width-adaptive specialist variant faulted validation. The requested atomic persistent med work queue was implemented last but the extension did not load and wholesale fallback measured 38789.021 us, so it was discarded. Keep this direction moving: diagnose that queue JIT/load failure and current-queue initialization, unify variable-width dense/PSD/spectral leaves behind one descriptor queue, move external compact-WY products into an explicit SM100 tcgen05/TMA producer-consumer kernel, and NCU the now-shorter cluster/T tails before choosing the next barrier or memory lever.
